packageRules.description: Pin the UAR and surreal-memory-server images (built by their own repos' CI) to exact digests. ci-supply-chain-pins moved these pins off the kustomize images transformer and into the Deployment manifests themselves (k8s/base/uar-deployment.yaml, k8s/base/memory-server-deployment.yaml), so the kubernetes manager tracks them there; docker-compose.yaml is tracked by the docker-compose manager.
knowme-web is built and pinned by this repo's own .github/workflows/site.yml on every deploy; Renovate must not open competing PRs against it.

SurrealDB is already pinned by digest with a rationale comment (see docker-compose.yaml and k8s/base/surrealdb-statefulset.yaml) matched to the exact version UAR and surreal-memory-server link against; bump it deliberately, not via an automated PR.
